newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa, coffee turnover falls in March.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa, coffee turnover falls in March.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa, coffee and sugar futures volume fell slightly in March but potatoes showed a marked increase, the exchange said on Wednesday.
In commodity options, wheat and sugar turnover fell sharply in March but cocoa posted a sharp rise.
Potatoes volume jumped to 1,601 lots in March from 693 in February while cocoa options soared to 3,622 from 670.
Wheat options fell to 683 lots from 1,008.
In cocoa futures, the March turnover stood at 171,804 lots against February's 184,495. Coffee fell to 118,200 from 154,553 while sugar dipped to 23,912 from 52,254.
Wheat and BIFFEX futures volume stood at 11,849 and 4,186, mostly unchanged from a month earlier. --Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
